narrative.overview: Aura is a warm paper notebook by day that dims to a lamp-lit page for reflection. Everything is built to be unjudging: low contrast between surfaces, hairline borders instead of shadows, one ink color for every action, and two small signal hues that inform rather than alarm.
keyCharacteristics: Warm paper neutrals; no pure white, no pure black, no cool grays.
A single ink (#2a2622) carries every primary action, active state and focus ring; there is no accent hue.
Brick red and sage green exist only to say drifting/missed and on track/done, at small scale.
Flat at rest. Hairline borders define surfaces; shadows appear only on floating things.
Dashed borders mean not tied to a goal or something you can add.
Fully rounded pills for actions and filters; 16px cards for content.

rules.name: The One Ink Rule
rules.body: Every primary action, active state and focus ring is Notebook Ink. Do not introduce an accent hue for buttons, links or selection.

rules.name: The Signal, Not Alarm Rule
rules.body: Brick and sage appear only as small badges, thin bars, checkbox fills, short text and the single sage suggestion panel. Never as a full-width banner, a page tint, or a button fill. A miss is information.

rules.name: The Mode Is a Mindset Rule
rules.body: Fazer is light and warm; Refletir is dim. The mode follows the route, never the OS setting. Do not add a manual theme toggle.

rules.name: The Dot-Separated Meta Rule
rules.body: Secondary information on one line, joined by " · ", sentence-cased, never wrapped into separate chips.

rules.name: The Weight Over Size Rule
rules.body: Promote by weight (400 → 500 → 600), not by jumping a size. Goal-linked content gets the heavier weight.

rules.name: The Flat-At-Rest Rule
rules.body: Cards, rows, badges and buttons carry no shadow. Shadows belong to things that float above the page.

dos: Do use Notebook Ink (#2a2622) as the only action color: primary buttons, active pills, focus rings, selected borders.
Do use hairline borders (1px #e4ddd3) and paper steps for separation; reserve shadows for floating layers.
Do signal state with the checkbox outline vocabulary (solid, dashed, brick, filled sage) and keep Brick/Sage to badges, thin bars, small text and the one suggestion panel.
Do give every prompt a quiet exit: closing, "Deixar assim" and ignoring are all valid; the secondary and link buttons are as visible as the primary.
Do switch the whole shell to the lamp palette on /refletir and keep theme-color in sync.
Do write meta lines as sentence-cased phrases joined by " · ".
Do keep every text pair at 4.5:1 or better and every control's sole boundary at 3:1, in both modes.
donts: Don't use Brick for large surfaces, full-width alerts, destructive-styled buttons or anything that reads as a verdict on the person.
Don't add a manual theme toggle or follow prefers-color-scheme; mode follows the route.
Don't introduce a colored accent for links, selection or CTAs.
Don't use pure white or pure black; stay on the warm paper and lamp scales.
Don't put shadows on cards, rows, badges or buttons.
Don't show scores, streak flames, confetti or a combined mood/completion "insight"; the product shows patterns as a mirror (see PRODUCT.md).
